text: Who are the best workers compensation lawyers in Canberra?

result.keyword: Who are the best workers compensation lawyers in Canberra?
result.markdown:
If you’re looking for **the best workers’ compensation lawyers in Canberra**, I’d put these firms at the top of the shortlist. I’m weighting **specialisation in ACT workers’ compensation, lawyer-level reputation, experience, and current client feedback**, rather than simply relying on Google ratings.

### My top Canberra picks

**1. Maliganis Edwards Johnson (MEJ) — strongest overall specialist pick**

MEJ is probably my **#1 choice for a serious or complex ACT workers’ compensation claim**. Its 2026 Doyle’s Guide results are particularly strong: MEJ was ranked a **Leading Workers Compensation firm**, while **Kirsten Leitch and Svetlana Todoroski were both ranked Preeminent** in workers compensation. [mej.com.au](https://mej.com.au/mej-named-a-leading-canberra-compensation-firm-for-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Kirsten Leitch is especially worth asking for: she leads MEJ's Workplace Injury Team and has substantial experience in workers compensation and workplace negligence claims. [mej.com.au](https://mej.com.au/meet-mej-partner-kirsten-leitch/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** complex claims, permanent impairment, workplace negligence, and cases likely to become contested.

---

**2. Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers — excellent specialist alternative**

Blumers is another very strong choice if you want a firm heavily focused on personal injury rather than general commercial law. Its Canberra team has multiple lawyers recognised in Doyle's Guide for workers compensation, including **Amy Burr (Preeminent), Chris Gribble (Leading), Phil Schubert (Recommended), Amber Wang and Noor Blumer (Recommended)** in the 2025 rankings. Blumers itself was a **Market Leader for Workers Compensation**. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/blumers-lawyers-are-some-of-the-best-lawyers-doyles-guide-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Phil Schubert and Noor Blumer also have extensive personal-injury experience. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/team/team-member/phil-schubert/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** workplace injuries where you want a highly specialised plaintiff/personal-injury practice.

---

**3. BDN Lawyers — excellent ACT-specific option**

BDN has a **dedicated workers compensation team focused specifically on workplace injuries in the ACT**, rather than treating it as a minor part of a general practice. [www.bdn.com.au](https://www.bdn.com.au/legal-services/personal-injury/workers-compensation-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One particularly attractive feature is its fee arrangement: BDN says that in ACT workers compensation matters, its professional fees and disbursements are generally paid by the workers compensation insurer if successful, and it also offers **no-win-no-fee** arrangements. [www.bdn.com.au](https://www.bdn.com.au/legal-services/personal-injury/workers-compensation-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

BDN also has a **4.9 Google rating** on its current site, with client feedback specifically mentioning its workers compensation assistance. [www.bdn.com.au](https://www.bdn.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** a straightforward ACT workers compensation claim, particularly if you want a well-established Canberra firm.

---

**4. Slater and Gordon Lawyers Canberra — strong large-firm option**

Slater & Gordon has a dedicated Canberra workers compensation practice and offers a **free initial appointment and no-win-no-fee arrangement**. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/workers-compensation/workers-compensation-lawyers-in-canberra?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The Canberra practice is led by **Martin Carrick**, who has more than 25 years' experience and says workers compensation is a particular area of his practice. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/people/martin-carrick?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** people who want the resources of a large national personal-injury firm, particularly for complicated or lengthy disputes.

---

**5. Masselos & Co — worth getting a quote from**

Masselos has been practising in personal injury compensation for **50+ years** and specifically handles workers compensation in Canberra. Its Canberra team is made up entirely of senior personal injury/compensation lawyers, and it offers a **free initial consultation and no-win-no-fee arrangement**. [masselos.com.au](https://masselos.com.au/our-offices/personal-injury-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

LawConnect currently shows **4.9/5 from 63 recommendations** for Masselos & Co. [lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/workers-compensation/act/canberra-2601?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** someone wanting a specialist compensation firm with a long track record.

---

### My shortlist

| Rank | Firm | My view |
|---|---|---|
| 🥇 | **MEJ** | Best overall for serious/complex ACT claims |
| 🥈 | **Blumers** | Excellent specialist personal-injury firm |
| 🥉 | **BDN** | Excellent ACT-specific workers comp practice |
| 4 | **Slater & Gordon** | Strong national firm + Canberra specialists |
| 5 | **Masselos & Co** | Very experienced compensation specialists |


There isn't really a single objectively "best" lawyer—the **best choice depends heavily on whether your claim is a denied claim, psychological injury, permanent impairment claim, common-law negligence claim, or something relatively straightforward**. Canberra Daily's current 2026 roundup also identifies MEJ, Blumers, BDN, United Legal and Slater & Gordon among Canberra's leading compensation firms. [canberradaily.com.au](https://canberradaily.com.au/best-compensation-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If this were my claim, I'd get initial consultations from MEJ and Blumers, then compare them with BDN.** Those three give you a particularly strong comparison of specialist Canberra practitioners.

[MEJ – workers compensation team](https://mej.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[Blumers – Canberra](https://www.blumers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[BDN Lawyers – workers compensation](https://www.bdn.com.au/legal-services/personal-injury/workers-compensation-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[Slater & Gordon – Canberra workers compensation](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/workers-compensation/workers-compensation-lawyers-in-canberra?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. back injury, psychological injury, bullying, denied claim, insurer stopped payments, permanent impairment, etc.)**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Canberra lawyers I'd contact first for your particular case**, including which individual solicitor I'd ask for.

items.markdown:
If you’re looking for **the best workers’ compensation lawyers in Canberra**, I’d put these firms at the top of the shortlist. I’m weighting **specialisation in ACT workers’ compensation, lawyer-level reputation, experience, and current client feedback**, rather than simply relying on Google ratings.

### My top Canberra picks

**1. Maliganis Edwards Johnson (MEJ) — strongest overall specialist pick**

MEJ is probably my **#1 choice for a serious or complex ACT workers’ compensation claim**. Its 2026 Doyle’s Guide results are particularly strong: MEJ was ranked a **Leading Workers Compensation firm**, while **Kirsten Leitch and Svetlana Todoroski were both ranked Preeminent** in workers compensation. [mej.com.au](https://mej.com.au/mej-named-a-leading-canberra-compensation-firm-for-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Kirsten Leitch is especially worth asking for: she leads MEJ's Workplace Injury Team and has substantial experience in workers compensation and workplace negligence claims. [mej.com.au](https://mej.com.au/meet-mej-partner-kirsten-leitch/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** complex claims, permanent impairment, workplace negligence, and cases likely to become contested.

---

**2. Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers — excellent specialist alternative**

Blumers is another very strong choice if you want a firm heavily focused on personal injury rather than general commercial law. Its Canberra team has multiple lawyers recognised in Doyle's Guide for workers compensation, including **Amy Burr (Preeminent), Chris Gribble (Leading), Phil Schubert (Recommended), Amber Wang and Noor Blumer (Recommended)** in the 2025 rankings. Blumers itself was a **Market Leader for Workers Compensation**. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/blumers-lawyers-are-some-of-the-best-lawyers-doyles-guide-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Phil Schubert and Noor Blumer also have extensive personal-injury experience. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/team/team-member/phil-schubert/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** workplace injuries where you want a highly specialised plaintiff/personal-injury practice.

---

**3. BDN Lawyers — excellent ACT-specific option**

BDN has a **dedicated workers compensation team focused specifically on workplace injuries in the ACT**, rather than treating it as a minor part of a general practice. [www.bdn.com.au](https://www.bdn.com.au/legal-services/personal-injury/workers-compensation-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One particularly attractive feature is its fee arrangement: BDN says that in ACT workers compensation matters, its professional fees and disbursements are generally paid by the workers compensation insurer if successful, and it also offers **no-win-no-fee** arrangements. [www.bdn.com.au](https://www.bdn.com.au/legal-services/personal-injury/workers-compensation-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

BDN also has a **4.9 Google rating** on its current site, with client feedback specifically mentioning its workers compensation assistance. [www.bdn.com.au](https://www.bdn.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** a straightforward ACT workers compensation claim, particularly if you want a well-established Canberra firm.

---

**4. Slater and Gordon Lawyers Canberra — strong large-firm option**

Slater & Gordon has a dedicated Canberra workers compensation practice and offers a **free initial appointment and no-win-no-fee arrangement**. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/workers-compensation/workers-compensation-lawyers-in-canberra?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The Canberra practice is led by **Martin Carrick**, who has more than 25 years' experience and says workers compensation is a particular area of his practice. [www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/people/martin-carrick?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** people who want the resources of a large national personal-injury firm, particularly for complicated or lengthy disputes.

---

**5. Masselos & Co — worth getting a quote from**

Masselos has been practising in personal injury compensation for **50+ years** and specifically handles workers compensation in Canberra. Its Canberra team is made up entirely of senior personal injury/compensation lawyers, and it offers a **free initial consultation and no-win-no-fee arrangement**. [masselos.com.au](https://masselos.com.au/our-offices/personal-injury-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

LawConnect currently shows **4.9/5 from 63 recommendations** for Masselos & Co. [lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/workers-compensation/act/canberra-2601?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for:** someone wanting a specialist compensation firm with a long track record.

---

There isn't really a single objectively "best" lawyer—the **best choice depends heavily on whether your claim is a denied claim, psychological injury, permanent impairment claim, common-law negligence claim, or something relatively straightforward**. Canberra Daily's current 2026 roundup also identifies MEJ, Blumers, BDN, United Legal and Slater & Gordon among Canberra's leading compensation firms. [canberradaily.com.au](https://canberradaily.com.au/best-compensation-lawyers-canberra/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If this were my claim, I'd get initial consultations from MEJ and Blumers, then compare them with BDN.** Those three give you a particularly strong comparison of specialist Canberra practitioners.

[MEJ – workers compensation team](https://mej.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[Blumers – Canberra](https://www.blumers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[BDN Lawyers – workers compensation](https://www.bdn.com.au/legal-services/personal-injury/workers-compensation-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
[Slater & Gordon – Canberra workers compensation](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/workers-compensation/workers-compensation-lawyers-in-canberra?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. back injury, psychological injury, bullying, denied claim, insurer stopped payments, permanent impairment, etc.)**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Canberra lawyers I'd contact first for your particular case**, including which individual solicitor I'd ask for.
